messages:
emma: Hey team — planning a joint GTM with Nimbus Cloud: Marketplace listing + partner webinar next month. Need a compact ops checklist: launch post, benchmark narrative, webinar runbook, inbound lead routing, messaging iteration. Who can own which? :sparkles:

raj: I can lead partner coordination and the marketplace listing. Need product blurbs, hero benchmark numbers, and the logo pack from Nimbus.

alex: I’ll own the benchmark narrative and slides. What's the target workload we want to showcase (tokens/seq length, batch size)?

sophie: Demand gen here — I’ll own webinar registration funnel, landing page copy, promo cadence. Need speaker confirms and a minimum 3-week lead time for ads.

karen: Ops: inbound lead routing question — do we push marketplace leads straight into the GTM Sales queue or route to a partner-specific queue first? Also need UTM and partner tagging spec.

raj: For the first run, route to GTM Sales with partner_tag=nimbus and lead_source=marketplace. We'll create an assignment rule that prioritizes leads with partner_tag. SLA: 24 hours to contact.

emma: Good. Alex — for the benchmark, let's aim to show: p95 latency < 120ms on 8k stream workload and ~2.1x cost improvement vs our baseline on the same GPU. Can you validate by EOD Fri?

alex: On it. Running final runs on 8k/16k seq tests now. Will upload results + screenshots to the bench doc and mark any caveats.

sophie: Proposed webinar slot: Tue 2026-03-30 9:00am PT. Panel: Raj, Alex, Nimbus PM (TBD), and a customer (BetaCorp). Thoughts on timing?

raj: 3/30 morning works for Nimbus. I'll confirm the Nimbus PM and ping BetaCorp for a customer quote and a short on-stage segment.

karen: For lead routing here's a minimal mapping snippet I recommend to hand to Eng / SFDC admin:
```json
{
  "utm_source": "nimbus_marketplace",
  "partner_tag": "nimbus",
  "route_to": "gtm-sales",
  "sla_hours": "24"
}
```
SFDC mapping: partner_tag -> Account.Partners__c, lead_source -> Lead.Source__c. Please include partner_tag in the registration form hidden fields.

emma: Nice. Sophie — promo cadence idea: 3 email touches (announce, reminder, last-chance), 2 organic social posts, 1 paid social push with Nimbus, and a co-host newsletter mention. I’ll draft the first-pass copy.

sophie: I’ll build the registration page template and add conversion tracking. Retargeting window = 30d, audience: webinar registrants & page viewers.

raj: Quick checklist + owners for clarity:
- Marketplace listing assets & approvals: raj
- Benchmark narrative + slides: alex
- Webinar ops (landing, registration, calendar invites): sophie
- Inbound routing & SFDC mapping: karen
- Launch post & social copy: emma

emma: Please update the shared tracker by Fri 5pm PT. I’ll compile the go-live package (assets, bench screenshots, speaker bios, tracking params) and send to Nimbus for approvals next Mon.

deploy-bot: Reminder: schedule the partner announcement posts in #marketing: 2026-03-28 10:00 PT :calendar:

emma: Thanks — I’ll follow up with calendar invites and a short PRD. If anyone hits blockers (assets or approvals), flag here so we can escalate to Partnerships. :+1:
